privacy_note: Synthetic examples only. Do not paste client-confidential data into the public workbench.

presets.label: SAP Sales: credit block review
presets.observed_behavior: Sales orders with a credit block wait in a shared review queue. Reviewers spend time collecting the same customer and order context.
presets.useful_function: Release safe orders quickly while keeping independent control for material credit risk.
presets.evidence: Queue age, block reason, credit exposure, order value, previous decisions, downstream correction.
presets.constraints: Authorization, credit policy, audit trail, commercial impact.

presets.label: SAP Procurement: purchase approval
presets.observed_behavior: Many purchase requests follow the same approval path although routine low-value requests are predictable and complete.
presets.useful_function: Approve routine procurement quickly without weakening spend control or segregation of duties.
presets.improve: approval lead time and touchless processing
presets.preserve: spend control, segregation of duties, and accountability
presets.evidence: Approval duration, value bands, account assignment, rejection reasons, change history.
presets.constraints: Release policy, authorization, SoD, budget and compliance rules.

presets.label: Master data: duplicate prevention
presets.observed_behavior: Data stewards review many requests manually because duplicate candidates and incomplete fields are discovered late.
presets.useful_function: Create clean master data quickly while keeping ambiguous identity decisions under accountable review.
presets.improve: request lead time and first-pass quality
presets.evidence: Request defects, duplicate matches, rejected requests, downstream corrections.
presets.constraints: Mandatory fields, duplicate policy, governance workflow, ownership.

presets.label: Integration: status polling
presets.observed_behavior: Several consumers poll a transactional system for status changes and duplicate similar read logic.
presets.useful_function: Keep consumers current without making them depend on frequent synchronous reads from the source.
presets.preserve: source independence, stability, and manageable load
presets.evidence: Read volume, latency, consumer freshness, source load, retry and timeout data.

presets.label: AI: operations agent
presets.observed_behavior: An assistant can diagnose incidents across several systems, but direct remediation tools would create a large blast radius.
presets.useful_function: Reduce diagnosis time with adaptive investigation without turning model reasoning into production authorization.
presets.preserve: production safety, accountability, and least privilege
presets.evidence: Incident history, tool traces, diagnosis accuracy, unsafe proposals, escalation rate.
presets.constraints: Least privilege, production safety, auditability, time and tool budgets.

presets.label: Process: global template vs local rules
presets.observed_behavior: A global process grows country and business-unit branches until the common flow becomes difficult to change and understand.
presets.useful_function: Keep enterprise policy common while allowing valid local decisions without copying the whole process.
presets.actor: Global process owner / local process owner
presets.evidence: Branch count, local change lead time, workaround rate, policy deviations.
presets.constraints: Global controls, local regulation, ownership, auditability.
